title: Text-to-Image Models and Their Representation of People from Different Nationalities Engaging in Activities

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models (DALL-E 3 and Gemini 3 Pro Preview) to generate images of people from 206 specific nationalities engaging in five everyday activities, manually labeling the images for the presence of traditional or impractical attire, and statistically analyzing the frequencies across World Bank regional classifications.

Evaluating 'AI Orientalism' by measuring how frequently text-to-image models default to stereotypical, culturally essentializing visual cues (like traditional clothing) even when impractical for the prompted activity. Additionally, analyzing the automated prompt-rewriting systems for the insertion of cultural descriptors like 'traditional', and comparing image-text alignment scores using CLIP, ALIGN, and GPT-4.1 mini.

Correlating the frequency of traditional or impractical attire in the generated images with the World Bank income group classifications (Low, Lower Middle, Upper Middle, High) of the specific countries prompted.
